<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bfdaba4322e1258a7657aa622af021e31ab071aa` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e510e960736a78761d5d426faad5418dec7b5f86` — the merge of head `2d19915cdc0c3038e47676735a6ab4cd8f659e96` into base `bfdaba4322e1258a7657aa622af021e31ab071aa`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e510e960736a78761d5d426faad5418dec7b5f86 && git checkout e510e960736a78761d5d426faad5418dec7b5f86
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bfdaba4322e1258a7657aa622af021e31ab071aa 2d19915cdc0c3038e47676735a6ab4cd8f659e96 && git checkout -B drift-repro bfdaba4322e1258a7657aa622af021e31ab071aa && git merge --no-ff 2d19915cdc0c3038e47676735a6ab4cd8f659e96

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bfdaba4322e1258a7657aa622af021e31ab071aa
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs bfdaba4322e1258a7657aa622af021e31ab071aa` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:数据源的同步门(`remote-tables`、`object-draft`)和 `/external/` 下的联邦孪生门(tables、draft、import、refresh-catalog)遇到不存在的数据源名字,改回 `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`,和 `GET /datasources/NAME` 一样,不再回 400 联邦拒绝。
- **为什么改**:原来的 400 让调用方以为请求格式错了、或要把数据源改声明成 external,其实是这个数据源根本不存在。
- **风险与回滚**:只换「名字不存在」这一种拒绝的状态码与错误码;存在但不是联邦源的数据源仍回 400 原码原因;包的公开导出不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`external-datasource-service.ts` 的 `assertFederationSource` 多出的一行,`rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts` 的 `answerThrown` 404 透传。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/federation-doors-unknown-name.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的**:无。非受管面,席位落地。

**席位意见:** ACCEPT。拒绝本来就有,只是换成和读门一致的 404;一个包里只剩一个「数据源不存在」的写法。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `2d19915cdc0c3038e47676735a6ab4cd8f659e96` · 2026-10-29T19:32Z

- **形态:** 9 files, +369/−46 across `service-datasource` and `rest`, two new test files, two existing pins moved, one changeset. No `packages/spec`, no governed path; Tier S.
- **Clause-②: no** (seat's reading): every name these doors refused before is still refused, nothing new is accepted or refused; only the refusal for a name with no definition moves from `400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` / `EXTERNAL_IMPORT_ERROR` to the `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` the by-name read already answers. The changeset states the before / now / unchanged. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **前提实测:** the new door pins red on `main` (the absent definition was folded into the non-federation 400); green on the fix; two ablation legs red, restored to the HEAD blob.
- **抽查读数:** the seat read the hunks: `assertFederationSource` keeps the primary-datasource refusal first, then `if (!ds) throw datasourceNotFoundError(datasource)`, then the non-federation 400 (whose `ds` is now non-optional); the two private helper copies are one module-level export of `datasource-admin-service.ts`, not re-exported from the package index; `GET /datasources/:name` spells its 404 through the same helper; `answerThrown` relays a 404 only when both `status === 404` and `code === 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'` are set. The two moved pins (no metadata service; `ghost` name) keep their intent (refused before any introspection) and now assert the 404.
- **门禁 check-runs:** 48 on this head: 34 success, 14 skipped, 0 other (read 2026-10-29T19:32Z); `mergeable_state: clean`. Derived gates 62/62, 0 NOT-MEASURED; service-datasource 1010/1010, rest 6674 green; `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- **接受的偏差:** PR footer and attribution line name the card thread's session (the thread's own attribution requirement); the seat patches the header to the seat signature and seat thread.
- **范围外去向:** `POST /datasources/:name/external/validate` skips the federation guard and answers an unknown name `200` with an empty report → #27696.
- **落地条款:** relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the merge queue.
